code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    def groups(n, cuts):
        out, start = [], 0
        for k in cuts + [n]:
            if k > start:
                out.append(range(start, k))
            start = k + 1
        return out
    rgs, cgs = groups(h, sep_rows), groups(w, sep_cols)
    cells = [grid[r][c] for rg in rgs for cg in cgs for r in rg for c in cg]
    bg = Counter(cells).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker_counts = Counter(cells)
    marker = next(v for v, n in marker_counts.most_common() if v != bg)
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in rg for c in cg) >= 2 else bg for cg in cgs] for rg in rgs]
'''
# Ensure the generalized implementation reproduces the test output and save it.
exec(code)
assert transform(grid)==out
